kv_rollup_note: attention probabilities are per QUERY head; SPEC 5.3 Mode 1 and Mode 2 act at KV-head granularity. The [l, kv_head, b] arrays are the mean over the query heads of each GQA group -- an APPROXIMATION, not a measurement. kv_head_dispersion_* reports the within-group spread the mean threw away; where it is comparable to the group mean the rollup summarises nothing and any Mode 1/2 table built from it is unsafe.
spec_12_3_note: SPEC 12.3's T<=2048 restriction is on distance-binned INTERVENTIONS, which need a [1, H, T, T] mask. Distance-binned CAPTURE chunks over query rows and has no such limit; these arrays were measured at the context length recorded in context_tokens.

provenance.caveat: measured on content-free contexts; attn_by_bin averages only the last 0.25 of query rows so causal masking does not masquerade as positional bias
provenance.sd_note: attn_by_bin_sd is None on a pooled object: the per-kind runs return a mean and an sd but not the per-context arrays, so a correct within-set spread cannot be reconstructed here. Each kind's own sd is in its own npz and in the summary.
